explanation: The Almighty Creator who judges all nations and calls His people to account.
The concept of breaking God's laws, especially through injustice toward the weak in society.
The time when God will punish evil and restore justice for His people.
The capital of the northern kingdom of Israel, threatened with destruction because of its sinfulness.
The capital of Judah, God's chosen city, which also faces judgment due to the corruption and injustice of its leaders.
The empty and abandoned landscape awaiting sinful nations after punishment has been carried out.
God's demand for right action, especially by protecting the poor and oppressed from abuse of power.
